subject: Lane D Cycle 1 DESIGN: first-open vs later-open causal trace contract
body: Observation-only paired trace using existing TransitionLab. Correlate processEpoch + serviceEpoch + openingAttemptId + currentGeneration + eventSequence + monotonicTimeNs. Identify the first divergent gate across process/service, accessibility, Shizuku, display topology, cold-cache/capture, surface/host, presentation and recovery. Logical display IDs are observations only.

event_envelope.wall_time: optional alignment only; causal ordering uses monotonicTimeNs

gates.proof: Distinguish same-process later success from restart/recovery.
Framework screenshot/window readiness and service lifetime.
Separate binder/bootstrap failure from downstream display/surface failure.
Detect stale display/engine use across cover->inner remap.
Test cold-cache hypothesis; ENTER without RETURN stays ambiguous without exception/death evidence.
Separate capture success from host/surface failure.
Show whether first failure seeds later success or later success follows restart.

minimal_exception_capture.privacy: No pixels, notification contents, messages, passwords, keystrokes or arbitrary user text.

critical_discriminators: First MISS then later same-process HIT with equal upstream readiness => cache branch is first known state divergence.
processEpoch change => cross-process recovery; no same-process warm-state inference.
ACCESSIBILITY_CAPTURE_ENTER then exception/death before RETURN => framework capture call becomes causal-bound candidate.
display removal/remap before old engine/display use without re-resolution => stale-display use.
capture success but host/surface failure => host/surface branch.
host/mirror attached but no useful presentation => presentation/readiness branch.
non_interference: No sleeps, threshold changes, retries, route mutations or wake changes.
Bounded/asynchronous existing TransitionLab writer where possible.
